top_signals.title: UK must focus on the Atlantic, ‘foundation’ of Britain’s security: Navy chief
top_signals.summary: The Royal Navy is spending a growing amount of time and resources to monitor Russian vessels, on average devoting two British warships every week to it.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Loan Dispersion Near An All-Time High: Sinjin Bowron
top_signals.summary: Sinjin Bowron, head of performing credit at Beach Point Capital Management, joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." They discuss the leveraged loan market after the Fed raises rates this week. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
